corrupt-outbox: The web SDK has no durable outbox to quarantine.
partial-batch: A per-event rejection invalidates the acknowledgement and resends the batch.
queue-full: The queue rejects each new arrival and retains its oldest events.
restart-mid-flush: A new browser client cannot replay the previous client's unacknowledged events.
retry-after: Retry-After longer than 30 seconds ends delivery.
unavailable: The third 503 ends delivery and the first two delays use the old backoff.
unknown-key: The SDK discards the batch on 401.
unload-in-flight: The page waits for its in-flight batch before sending the queued event.
